sections.content: Use si + imperfect subjunctive to introduce a hypothetical present or future situation, followed by the conditional for its consequence.

items.spanish: Si tuviera la opción, elegiría otra.
items.english: If I had the option, I would choose another one.
If I could decide, I would prefer to wait.

items.spanish: Si tuviéramos más información, decidiríamos con más confianza.
items.english: If we had more information, we would decide with more confidence.
